_readme: Tools share the B button with spells (cycle with RB). type: bomb | hookshot. 'ammo' = item consumed per use.

bombs.name: Bombs
bombs.description: Place a bomb. Blasts enemies, pots and cracked walls. Stand back!

hookshot.name: Hookshot
hookshot.description: Fires a chain. Latches onto hook posts to pull you across pits. Stuns enemies.
